prompt:

Place the hair crown only 5% below the TOP edge. Cut the BOTTOM edge across the UPPER CHEST. Keep the face proportions natural and preserve the exact facial expression and eye direction.
The blurred listener is almost entirely outside the right edge: show only a thin sliver of hair and shoulder along the outermost 10-15% of that edge, including the bottom corner. The sharp face is dominant.

保持同一张脸、表情、视线、服装、肩带状态、光线与背景机位；胸口以下道具和动作留在原位画外。
Keep the same photographic look, lighting and camera direction. Final image portrait 9:16.
